name: Autrance
description: Trance pluck auto phrase generator for NTS-3. Hold the pad to run a tempo-synced 16-step pattern. Root hits and chord extensions (9th, 11th, 13th above the step root) are generated as separate layers. Touch again to regenerate. X = Cutoff, Y = Resonance, Depth = mix. Up to 8 voices polyphonic.
